issues.description: The Milkable interface method messageOnMilk has inconsistent parameter lists across artifacts. The problem statement (UML and textual spec) and the template Main expect a parameterless method messageOnMilk() that returns a String such as "[Animal Type] [name] is milked" (see problem_statement.md). However, the solution repository declares Milkable.messageOnMilk(double volume) and provides implementations in Goat and Seal that require a double parameter and include the volume in the returned string. This disparity (no-arg vs. one double parameter) will cause compilation errors or prevent students from implementing the interface to match the provided Main and the exercise specification.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the Milkable API consistent across problem statement, template, and solution. Preferably revert the solution to the no-argument signature: change Milkable to declare String messageOnMilk(), and update Seal and Goat implementations to implement messageOnMilk() returning the expected format (e.g. "Seal Clarabelle is milked"). Alternatively, if a volume parameter is intentionally required, update the problem statement, the template Main (call sites), and the exercise text to document messageOnMilk(double) and the expected return format, and adjust tests accordingly. Apply the chosen API uniformly in all artifacts.
